text:
Romy Alvarez: Thinking about the header migration again. Proposal: support per-tenant grace windows (so large customers can get more time) + telemetry buckets so console owners can see progress.
Noah Kim: Per-tenant sounds sensible. How would server evaluate tenant config? feature flag + ttl?
Romy Alvarez: Feature flag stored in tenant config with fields: `grace_enabled:true`, `grace_ends_at: 2026-05-15T00:00Z`, `grace_window_seconds: 3600`. Server checks the flag on auth lookup.
Eva Morales: For SDKs we'll expose `routing.migrate({graceUntil: isoString})` and env var `RW_ROUTE_GRACE_UNTIL`. Default: preserve current header behavior.
Tariq Shah: Telemetry buckets: emit events that tag requests as `route_migration_bucket: old_only | new_only | both | unknown`. Console will chart % per org over time.
Ava Brooks: Important: quota ledger must not count a request twice if both headers present. Suggest canonicalization: map both to `route_id` derived from priority table, use request-id dedupe for retries.
Noah Kim: Does this require changes to the ledger DB schema? we could add `during_migration BOOLEAN` and `migration_bucket TEXT` columns.
Tariq Shah: Minimal changes: append `migration_bucket` as string to meter events (no schema migration needed immediately), then backfill dashboards. If we want per-usage quota rules we may need a small column later.
Romy Alvarez: Edge case: SDKs might flip header generation but proxies between app and our edge could rewrite headers. We should instrument `received_via_proxy` tag in events.
Eva Morales: For the TS SDK I'll add helpers: `migrateRouting({graceUntil, emitTelemetry: true})`. It'll automatically send a one-off telemetry ping `sdk_migration_opt_in` with `sdk_version` and `language`.
Ava Brooks: UX: Console rollout modal should include an org-level ETA estimate: "estimate X days until 90% traffic moved" derived from linear extrapolation of buckets. Also a per-route list.
Noah Kim: Testing: add e2e that simulates tenant flag set, old+new headers, retries, and verifies ledger only increments once and event bucket correct.
Tariq Shah: I'll prototype a dedupe algorithm: prefer request-id, else fingerprint = sha1(client_ip + path + 250ms window). Post results.
Eva Morales: For Py SDK, default behavior unchanged. migrateRouting will be opt-in; also add `--migrate-routing` CLI flag for CLI users.
Romy Alvarez: Ownership: Tariq infra dedupe spike, Eva SDK changes (py/ts), Noah quota/ledger mapping, Ava console tile + rollout modal. I'll open cross-team task list.
infra-bot: ticket RED-1876 created: "Per-tenant route header grace windows + telemetry buckets" (est 6d).
Ava Brooks: Timeline: SDK helper PRs in 10 days, console tile in 14 days, infra canary in 18 days.
Noah Kim: One more metric: add `percent_new_by_route` and `time_to_90pct_new` computed nightly so accounts get scheduled reminders.
Romy Alvarez: Good. Also document migration checklist and add code snippets to dev-examples.
Tariq Shah: I'll post my spike logs and a small benchmark of fingerprint collisions by EOD tomorrow.
Eva Morales: Fine with the plan. I'll keep the SDK helper small and non-breaking.
Romy Alvarez: If no objections, I'll PR the RFC tomorrow morning. :rocket:
